drop: Or drop a {format} or {archive} file here.
privacy: Your comic stays on this device.
damaged: The archive could not be read. It may be damaged or use unsupported {archive} features.
how: Choose a {format} file or drag it into the reader. You can also open a {archive} archive that contains comic page images.
Use the arrows to turn pages, enter a page number to jump there, or open the thumbnail grid to find a scene.
Choose Fit page to see the whole image or Fit width and zoom to read small text. Switch to right-to-left reading for manga, or use focus mode to give the comic more room.
formatBody: A {format} file is a comic book archive that uses {archive} compression. It stores pages as images, often in chapter folders. The reader sorts the full filenames in natural order, so page 2 comes before page 10, and skips hidden files and files that aren't images.
compatibilityBody: Read comics with JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP and BMP pages, plus AVIF in browsers that support it. Password-protected or split archives need to be unpacked first. Large solid archives can take longer to open and turn pages because several images may share the same compressed block.
privacyBody: Your browser opens the archive on your device. There is no upload, account or installation. To read a ZIP-based comic, use the CBZ reader.
